'''2007 Worlds Day 2 Pat Jurgens LS We'll Handle This''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Pat Jurgens]] at [[2007 World Championship]] (Day 2).

Sheet deck title '''Wookiee Power''' (inventory also Wookies Revised / Wimp Raised). Partner Dark Side sheet not in Day 2 fax pages 1–32. Objective from W/HAP shorthand + Naboo Theed sites → [[We'll Handle This / Duel Of The Fates|We'll Handle This]]. Sensible Route (V) and Saesee Tiin published as written (may redlink). Shatterpoint → [[Shattered Hope (V)]]; A-wing/B-wing → [[Green Squadron A-wing]] / [[B-wing Attack Fighter]]; Jar Jar sheet (V) → [[Jar Jar Binks]]; Into Battle → [[Jedi Business]].
